info.name: RM Blockchain Transparency API (Kelompok 14)
info.description:
Postman collection for the Flask API in server.py — a simulation of a blockchain-based transparency system for reducing corruption (COMP6696001 Final Project, Group 14).

The server runs locally at http://127.0.0.1:5000. Start it first with:

    python server.py

Then run the requests below in order: Register a recipient (CREATE), view all transactions (READ), then manipulate a record (UPDATE) to demonstrate the corruption loophole the paper discusses.

request.description: Registers a new aid recipient. Sends nama, alamat_wallet and jumlah as JSON. The server assigns an auto-incrementing id and returns the created record with HTTP 201.
Returns the full list of registered recipients/transactions currently held in the in-memory database.

Overwrites the wallet address and amount of the record with id = 1. This intentionally demonstrates how a centralized, mutable database can be tampered with — the problem a blockchain-based transparency system is designed to prevent. Change the trailing '1' in the path to target a different record id.
